releases.notes:
Added Cauldron Cooking

  • You can now cook using cauldron. It's much better for boiling, cooking liquidish meals, stews or deepfrying. It's reccomended to use JEI to know recipes of new food items, since Cauldron doesn't have GUI.
  • When Cauldron is placed above the heat source (fire, magma, campfires, lava) it starts to boil. Boiling cauldron can be used for cooking. It has six slots, which you can fill one by one with right-clicking on it. When craft is right, cauldron will start sizzling and emmit smoke, and after 10 seconds the dish will be ready to pick up. Depending on type of dish you can either get the result with hand, bowl or bottle, depleeting the water in process.
  • If cauldron with items has been destroyed or no longer can be cooked in all items will drop out, and bottles with buckets with liquids are given back after cooking is complete

Added Sweetness effect

  • Some types of food are now considered to be Sweet. There are four distinct types of them: sweetned, sweet, sugared and candied. The sweeter food is the stronger and/or longer is the effect.
  • While under Sweetness effect all non-sweet food will restore more hunger points, depending on the level of effect.

Added New Potions

  • Potions of Flame and Snowflake are added. To make them you can brew mint in brewing stand using thick potion, by default it will become Snowflake potion, which can be extended with redstone or inverted to Flame potion with fermented spider eye.
  • Snowflake potion makes everything around you to freeze and snow, attacked enemies will get frozen and fire will be put out.
  • Flame potion makes everything around you to melt, attacked enemies will get set on fire and sprinting will leave fire trail.

Added Bottle o' Obsidian Tears

  • Can be obtained by right-clicking crying obsidian with empty bottle.
  • Drinking such liquid will make you obtain Instability effect.
  • During Instability - all damage causes you to teleport randomly in short range. You can appear anywhere from air, cave to inside of a wall. Also you won't be able to get trough dimension portals, insted you'll be pushed out and suffer decent rift damage.

Added New Foods

  • Obviously.
  • Most of the new foods are made with cauldron.

Added More Achivements

  • New achivements are added, none of them are hidden.

Less important additions: Added Wild Carrot, some changes to previous recipes, new trades with villagers, added more tags for compatability.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/seb-sish/Concoction/compare/1.3.0...1.4.0

Added Sunflowers
- Indeed! New sunflowers replace old ones, however you still can obtain vanilla sunflowers which were repurposed as item instead of block now. It can be used to feed almost any animal in the game.
- Two-block high crop that can grow on any dirt-like-block.
- Has six stages. When fully grown seeds can be harvested from the top block with right-click.
- Their seeds can be roasted and eaten. In the future updates you'll be able to make oils with it to cook more diffrent foods.

Added Small Pillows
- Slab variants of pillows for even more decorative use. They use diffrent side-texture, but do behave the same as their full-block counterparts.
- Obviously can be dyes into all sixteen colours.

Added New Music Disc
- New music disc with track "Hot Ice" can be obtained after creeper explodes stray.

Added Russian Localization
- Mod now fully supports Russian language. If anyone would want to volunteer translating mod to other languages please let us know.

Added More Tags and Achivements
- Two more new achivements connected to pillows are added. One of them is hidden.
